_description: CSS variables in :root that may legitimately differ between a default-slot (Korean) template and its -en (English) counterpart. Anything not listed here must match across the pair. See references/design.md for the typography rules these allowances support.

per_pair_allowed._doc: key = template base name (e.g. 'one-pager'); value = list of additional CSS variables that may differ for that pair only. Slide templates may drift on per-template typography metrics; see references/design.md slide-deck section.
